Collection Description
# Restful-Booker API Testing - V3 (Simple) Target: https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com (public practice API) ## How to run 1. Import the collection. Select an environment only if you want to override Base_URL. 2. Run the whole collection in the Collection Runner, in order (folder 12 last, it deletes the test data). 3. Any single folder can also be run alone: every folder creates its own booking and the collection logs in automatically. ## Collection variables | Variable | What it is for | |---|---| | Base_URL | API address (an environment variable with the same name overrides it) | | rb_admin_user / rb_admin_pass | Login of the public demo API | | rb_run_known_defects | true = defect / validation / exploratory checks run (and fail when the bug is there). false = they are SKIPPED (for a green run). An environment variable with the same name overrides this value | | rb_max_response_ms | Response time limit in ms (default 5000) | | rb_token, rb_booking_id, rb_cleanup_ids | Filled in automatically while the collection runs | ## Folders 01 Health | 02 Authentication | 03 CRUD core | 04 Filtering | 05 Update/Patch | 06 Boundary | 07 Negative/Auth | 08 Robustness | 09 Delete/State | 10 Defects | 11 Exploratory | 12 Cleanup ## Notes - Test names look like `PREFIX_NNN - description` (LIST, AUTH, POST, READ, FILTER, PUT, PATCH, PERSIST, ...). - If a PUT or PATCH fails, the GET Verify request after it will also fail. Look at the FIRST failure. - Filter tests for checkin / checkout assume: checkin = "on or after the date", checkout = "on or before the date". Check this in the API docs. - If the server answers 403, the saved token is cleared and the next request logs in again. - Newman: `newman run restful_booker_API_Testing_Final_Simple.postman_collection.json --env-var "rb_run_known_defects=false"` for a run without the known-defect checks.
